headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals continued their winning streak with an 8-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, led by Jordan Walker's home run and three RBIs. The Houston Astros shut out the Chicago Cubs 3-0, with Christian Walker leading the offense with a 3-for-3 performance, including two home runs and three RBIs.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Tampa Bay Rays right fielder Jonny DeLuca, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Other players on the injured list include Brant Hurter of the Detroit Tigers, Lourdes Gurriel Jr. of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Carter Baumler of the Texas Rangers, Jordan Hicks of the Chicago White Sox, Mickey Moniak of the Colorado Rockies, Jung Hoo Lee of the San Francisco Giants, and Burch Smith of the Detroit Tigers.

The Philadelphia Phillies made a trade, sending RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money. Other trades include the Cincinnati Reds trading RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, the Tampa Bay Rays trading LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, and the Toronto Blue Jays trading LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall Short in Cincinnati**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dropped a 7-6 decision to the Cincinnati Reds, with Jordan Walker leading the offense going 3-for-4 with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, winning 3-0. Christian Walker led the Astros' offense with a 3-for-3 performance, including two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Patrick Corbin earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Rays Place RF Jonny DeLuca on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right fielder Jonny DeLuca has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, retroactive to May 23, 2026.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have made a trade, sending RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
